proposed_widenings.name: mixed_magic_item_mechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines always-on passive benefits with a separate reaction-based charge-spend ability, but MagicItemMechanics currently allows only one family at a time.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This beetle-shaped medallion provides three benefits while it is on your person.

proposed_widenings.name: save_source_filter_against_spells
proposed_widenings.justification: Current roll-advantage shaping can narrow by save ability, but not by the source of the save such as spells.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells.

proposed_widenings.name: failed_saving_throw_reaction_trigger
proposed_widenings.justification: The preservation benefit triggers after a failed save and needs source predicates for Necromancy spells or harmful effects from Undead.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw against a Necromancy spell or a harmful effect originating from an Undead, you can take a Reaction ...

proposed_widenings.name: override_save_outcome
proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction rewrites an already failed saving throw into a success, which is not modeled by numeric modifiers or advantage.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ... turn the failed save into a successful one.

notes: No content file was authored. Defense, 12 charges, and destruction on empty fit existing shapes, but the item as a whole needs a mixed passive-plus-reaction magic-item shape and save-source/result-override support.
